sourceTitle: How Enron Made Its Money Disappear
title: Most Innovative Company In America. Then This.
hook: Most innovative company in America. Six years running.
question: What's winning awards now?

scenes.narration: Fortune named Enron America's most innovative company. Six years running.
At its peak it was worth seventy billion dollars. Its stock fell from ninety dollars to twenty-six cents.
The largest bankruptcy in history at the time. Twenty thousand jobs, gone almost overnight.
scenes.label: jobs gone overnight

scenes.narration: So what is winning awards right now?
